podcast.body: This song appeared on the 1979 album "Damn the Torpedoes" and was subsequently released as a single in the summer of 1980. Its release marked a significant breakthrough for Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers. The track is also recognized as part of a larger collection of music that champions the optimism often found among the downtrodden, a key theme within the Heartland Rock genre. "This song was released as a single in the summer of 1980 And I think it's fair to say it was the breakthrough for Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers."
